name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber PLA @base
filament_notes:
15% chopped-carbon-fiber PLA/HTPLA; covers Carbon Fiber PLA, High Temp CF PLA and Recycled CF PLA.
FAQ range 195-220C (TDS 205C); Material Data Table: 220C@6, 240C@12 mm3/s, 55C plate. Hardened nozzle and drive gears recommended - fiber is abrasive. Proto-Pasta cites good results with 0.5 mm nozzles and spring-loaded direct-drive extruders. Filament is brittle in spool form - avoid sharp bends.
Recycled variant prints the same.
